'''Emberwold''' is a long-running low-fantasy series in mystic realism. Its tagline: ''"The map ends where the truth begins."''

Ten Great Houses have ruled [[the Banner-lands]] since the [[War of the Unification]] ended four hundred years ago, and each is less a family than a philosophy of leadership. The reader's question is never which house is good — it is: '''which house would you follow?'''

The name of the world: ''ember'' — the glow that survives a fire; ''wold'' — an old word for open country, a half-step from ''world''. The glow-land that sounds like the glow-world.
